Every click is a demand signal — see docs/interest-capture.md for what the signals decide. Teaser topics informed by the Quantic MSAIE Class of Nov 2027 cohort syllabus (owner-provided, 2026-07).
zoneTitle: The Architect Track — In the Workshop
zoneIntro: The deep end of the platform: designing, evaluating, and governing AI systems at production scale. These modules are being built from real platform work — not textbook exercises. Tap what you'd take. We build in order of demand.

teasers.title: Case Study: Building This Platform
teasers.hook: The learning platform you're using was designed, evaluated, and governed with the exact practices it teaches. Walk through the real decisions — including the ones that went wrong.

teasers.title: Capstone Lab: Design an Evaluation Harness
teasers.hook: Pick one workflow your team runs with AI today. Leave with a working eval pipeline that tells you — before your users do — when it quietly gets worse.

teasers.title: Governance Drill: The Model Update That Breaks Things
teasers.hook: A tabletop exercise: the vendor ships a model update overnight and three of your AI workflows start behaving differently. Who notices, who decides, who rolls back? Find out before it's real.

teasers.title: Agentic Workflow Engineering
teasers.hook: Beyond chains: planner, implementer, tester, reviewer — designing multi-agent workflows with bounded scopes, tool contracts, and failure protocols that survive contact with production.
teasers.backlogRef: Quantic MSAIE capability area; agent-orchestration Evolution Library entry (published 2026-07-10)

teasers.title: Foundation Model Integration Patterns
teasers.hook: Model selection, fallback tiers, caching, and the rowboat-vs-speedboat economics of routing work between small local models and frontier ones.
teasers.backlogRef: Quantic MSAIE capability area; token-economics Evolution Library entry (published 2026-07-10)

teasers.title: Scaling Intelligent Infrastructure
teasers.hook: What changes when it's not one workflow but forty: observability, prompt/version control, drift detection, and the platform team that keeps organizational AI honest.
teasers.backlogRef: Quantic MSAIE capability area; D-series expansion

teasers.title: Fine-Tune or Prompt? The Shape-the-Model Decision
teasers.hook: Sometimes the answer isn't a better prompt or more context — it's changing the model itself. When fine-tuning beats prompting, what it costs, and why it's usually the wrong first move.
teasers.backlogRef: Gap identified from Quantic MSAIE syllabus (ML → AI Model Fine-Tuning block); no current-catalog analog
